minor.issue: Capped at to_list(24) while requirement says show ALL Elite students; fine today (1 Elite) but will silently truncate later.

find_one status!='paid' then update is not atomic (verify + cashfree status poll could both run). Harmless today thanks to purchases unique index/upsert, but use find_one_and_update({id, status:{$ne:'paid'}}) to be safe.

integration_issues.issue: iframe src and Download link hit /api/me/book/file directly (cookie only, no axios refresh). If the 15-min access token expires while the page is open, Download PDF / iframe reload return 401 JSON instead of the PDF. Consider refreshing token before download or fetching via api blob.
Android Chrome cannot render PDFs inside an iframe (shows blank/opens download); iOS shows only the first page. Consider a fallback 'Open in new tab' link or pdf.js viewer for mobile.
